baseline: reuse E39-T0 only after provenance and 16-step numerical prefix replay
prefix: 16 disposable T0 updates per seed for contract verification, not a new baseline
preflight_gate: Both seeds: event-mean old-underestimated subset shares of local loss and gradient L2 increase for all/harmful/oracle endpoint roles; weight conservation and finite gradients. No coefficient adjustment.
mechanism_gate: Both seeds T1 vs T0: train net gain up and H_loss down, dev net gain up; record tail and trajectories separately
deployment_gate: both seed recoveries >=20%; both dev trajectories positive; Set>Independent and no-op; mean relative gain nonnegative; harm count, P10, worst absolute harm improve vs E29
test: sealed regardless of diagnostic progress; no automatic unsealing
